tool.help:
**macrel_contigs**
A tool that mines antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) from (meta)genomes by predicting peptides from genomes (provided as contigs) and outputs all the predicted anti-microbial peptides found.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: macrel/contigs - Container: biocontainers/macrel:1.4.0--pyh7e72e81_0
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
